services.desc: You can find many breweries along the south coast from Brookings to Coos Bay. Don’t forget the DD! Learn more here. There are multiple opportunities for fishing either fresh or saltwater. Go on your own or hire a guide. As they say, a bad day fishing is better than… Learn more here. blurb: We had a wonderful experience at this beautiful little RV park. The parking pads were all smooth, level, and spacious. The landscaping was impeccable. The bathrooms and showers were very well designed and clean. Most importantly the camp host greeted us warmly as we pulled in and the owner greeted us and offered assistance if needed as we were leaving. This was a most pleasurable stay.
